Leah M: Morning team  I'm Leah (new AE). Finished HR but hitting a few blockers: HubSpot role = viewer only, Gong invite not in inbox, Dialpad shows "no extension available", and I can't find the AE playbook link. Who should I poke?
Chris (Sales Ops): Welcome Leah! Tagging Sales Ops. Can you confirm your exact work email and manager?
Leah M: leah.m@redwood.ai; manager: Ana. Thanks!
Chris (Sales Ops): Cool. Submitting one consolidated provisioning request. Payload I sent to IT: ```Name: Leah Martinez
Email: leah.m@redwood.ai
Manager: Ana (Enablement)
Role: Account Exec
Requests: HubSpot (Sales Rep perms), Gong user, Dialpad ext, sandbox access, AE playbook access```
Leah M: Appreciate the fast turnaround. ETA?
ProvisionBot: Provisioning ticket created by Chris (Sales Ops). Ticket RB-20260328-301. ETA 20-60 minutes.
Ana (Sales Enablement): Hi Leah  welcome! AE playbook is here: https://confluence.redwood.internal/sales/ae-playbook. I just added you to the "AE Onboard" share and dropped the 1-week checklist and first-10-calls cheat sheet in #sales-resources.
Vik (CS): Once Gong is live, ping me and I'll share the CS handoff snippet + pre-call checklist. Quick tip: enable auto-transcripts and set highlights visibility to team for mentor feedback.
Chris (Sales Ops): Update: HubSpot perms escalated, invite resent. Gong invite resent (check spam/promotions). Dialpad extension queued  should be assigned in ~30 mins. Sandbox account created: sandbox-leah@redwood-sandbox.io (link emailed).
Leah M: Got HubSpot access and sandbox link. Dialpad still pending, no Gong yet.
Chris (Sales Ops): Dialpad ext assigned: 1642. You should receive setup SMS; if not use the web setup link sent by email. Gong manual add in progress.
Leah M: SMS arrived, MFA setup done, test call OK. Gong appeared after manual add  I can access. Thanks!
Ana (Sales Enablement): Pushed two Gong highlight templates and 3 email snippets to your Drive folder. HubSpot snippets are under Snippets > AE Templates. Sequences: HubSpot > Sequences > "AE - First 10 Touches".
Leah M: One more Q: where are the customer one-pagers and case studies? Need for prep.
Ana (Sales Enablement): Drive -> Sales Collateral -> One-Pagers and CaseStudies. I granted view+comment. If you need editable slides I moved copies into your Drive.
Vik (CS): I'll add you to a 20-min shadow of a renewals call later today. Drop highlights and tag me for quick feedback.
Leah M: Perfect  jumping into the sandbox to seed contacts and run a mock. Thanks everyone! :raised_hands:
Chris (Sales Ops): Closing RB-20260328-301 when post-provision checks pass. Reopen if anything else breaks.
